notes: The pasted email tracks the draft window properly now. Mail honours the width=100% HTML attribute but ignores a CSS width:100% when the pasted content has no definite width to resolve it against - so the tables sized to their content while the paragraphs filled, which is exactly the split you were seeing. Every CSS width and min-width is out of the email; the width attributes do the work. Also drops the strapline beside the app title.
